This site re-implements the applied examples from Scott Cunningham's [*Causal Inference: The Mixtape*](https://mixtape.scunning.com) with [CausalPy](https://causalpy.readthedocs.io). It is a translation of the analyses, not a copy of the book. Follow the chapter links for identification strategy and narrative.

A translation by [Benjamin T. Vincent](https://drbenvincent.github.io/).

Estimates are Bayesian (PyMC) unless a section says otherwise. Numbers will not match the book's OLS tables exactly. Each chapter records where they differ and why.

Outputs are frozen in `_freeze/`. A project render republishes the saved plots and does not re-sample. Re-running a chapter is a local edit, not a CI step.
